claims.text: GDACS rates Tropical Cyclone MURASU-26 (event id 1001346, GLIDE TC-2026-000199-IND) an Overall Red alert (GDACS score 2.5, JTWC single-source maximum expected impact), with the event window running 1 November 2026 00:00 UTC to 3 November 2026 06:00 UTC. Maximum sustained winds are 157 km/h (Category 2, JTWC model; other models range 68-148 km/h), with about 1.5 million people exposed to Category 1 or higher winds in India and high vulnerability assessed for the country. GDACS's PAGER-style casualty section is empty; no deaths, injuries or damage have been reported.

description: A tropical cyclone tracking through the Bay of Bengal was placed under a GDACS Red alert as it approached India's eastern coast in early November 2026. GDACS assessed Tropical Cyclone Murasu at Category 2 strength, with maximum sustained winds of 157 km/h and about 1.5 million people exposed to Category 1 or higher winds, citing a potential high humanitarian impact. No casualty, injury or damage figure has yet been confirmed by an authoritative source, and the storm's precise landfall point has not been reported.

impact.summary: GDACS's tropical cyclone report for MURASU-26 (event id 1001346, episode 10) rates the storm an Overall Red alert — a potential high humanitarian impact — with maximum sustained winds of 157 km/h (Category 2, JTWC) and about 1.5 million people exposed to Category 1 or higher winds in India; the event window runs 1-3 November 2026. No death, injury or displacement figure has been confirmed by an authoritative source.

location.region: Bay of Bengal, India's eastern coast near Andhra Pradesh

name: Tropical Cyclone Murasu — India
